title: New Round of Trump Threats and Pullbacks Raises Uncertainty in Mideast
summary: Analysts and lawmakers are trying to divine whether Mr. Trump’s latest announcement means negotiations with Iran will truly get underway Monday or if the president is just working through unappealing options.
